section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the emphasis on the glory of the latter Temple is because it is the root of all future revelations, including the resurrection of the dead.
section.t: And this is: "Great will be the glory of this latter house more than the first,"
for although in the future redemption there will be many matters, up to and including the resurrection of the dead which is the last of them all,
the main emphasis is on the glory of this latter house,
because the root of all the matters will be in the Holy Temple,
and from it they will be drawn into the world

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section states that the first action of Moshiach is building the Temple, as it is the root of all subsequent matters, and concludes with a prayer for this to happen soon.
section.t: And this is also one of the reasons that the first action of Moshiach
is the building of the Holy Temple74,
for this is the root of all the matters that follow.
And may it be His will, and primarily, that all this be very soon.
